name: HYDRA-UMC-SDK
build: Functional JSON Schema v1 contracts, a real first OpenAPI v1 slice for HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's own HTTP surface, plus real, tested Python, Go, TypeScript and Rust reference clients and conformance fixtures.
notes: The common contract and conformance boundary for services, UIs, CM5 adapters and URTC. Provides the v1 JSON Schemas, a Python reference validator, Go, TypeScript and Rust clients that enforce the published schemas, conformance fixtures, a schema/validator compatibility matrix (tools/verify_contract_matrix.py), a differential test of the Python validator against the schemas, and an OpenAPI v1 slice of HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's discovery, sign-in, settings and command routes (a subset of the server's own docs/openapi.json). Bridge helpers: BridgeJob/GateDecision, job intake with an idempotency store, MQTT connection settings, an Operation lifecycle with evidence-based success, Capability checks and a durable promotion journal. Protobuf is not published yet.
